questions.question: How many competitive acting Oscars has Harrison Ford won?
questions.note: One nomination, for Witness. He has a few honorary prizes. Pub nights want zero.

questions.question: Before Star Wars, Ford was working on Lucas’s lot in what trade?
questions.note: The story is that he was hanging a door when Lucas asked him to read Han. He had already been in American Graffiti.

questions.question: In which U.S. city was Harrison Ford born?
questions.note: July 13, 1942. He is often tied to Wyoming later, where he keeps a ranch and flies.

questions.question: What is Ford’s rank-and-name role in Apocalypse Now?
questions.note: A short briefing-room part. The name is a nod to George Lucas, who was once meant to direct the film.

questions.question: Which film came first, Star Wars or Raiders of the Lost Ark?
choices: They were released the same summer
Raiders, then the Star Wars sequels
questions.note: Star Wars 1977, Raiders 1981. Ford was already Han when Spielberg put him in the fedora.

questions.question: Ford’s then-wife Melissa Mathison wrote which 1982 Spielberg film?
choices: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.note: Mathison also wrote The Black Stallion. Ford has a tiny, mostly cut cameo as the school principal in E.T.

questions.question: Who is usually credited with creating Indiana Jones, before Spielberg directed the films?
questions.note: Lucas had the serial-adventure idea. He and Spielberg shaped it in Hawaii. Kaufman and Kasdan worked on story and script.

questions.question: In Sabrina (1995), what is Ford’s Linus Larrabee?
questions.answer: The workaholic brother who runs the company
choices: The workaholic brother who runs the company
questions.note: Bogart had the part in 1954. Ford’s Linus falls for the chauffeur’s daughter after she comes back from Paris.

questions.question: After the Cairo truck chase in Raiders, what does Indy tell Sallah he is doing?
questions.answer: Making this up as I go
choices: Making this up as I go
questions.note: Sallah asks if Indy has a plan. Ford shrugs the whole serial-adventure into one line.

questions.question: Besides acting, Harrison Ford is famously licensed as a what?
questions.note: He flies himself to work when he can. Trivia nights treat it like the carpenter story: part of the Ford kit.
